title: VIXEN Release build requires manual SdfCore kernel regeneration
body: The final Release build failed at sdf_core_kernels_check because VIXEN/libraries/SVO/shaders/recipe/SdfCoreKernels.g.glsl was stale by one generator loop-bound line. Recovery required a separate queued generator invocation without --check, followed by a queued worktree check; only then did the full Release build pass. Suggested consolidation: make the VIXEN build expose a canonical regenerate-and-check dependency or make the check consume the generator output from the same configured source closure.
